answer: Copying the same citations across 245 aliases hence pays the reading cost 245 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the inlet check immediately, the pulse audit keeps the resolved set and the whisper replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
